natural_body: SMB 40% discounts lifted acquisition and near-term revenue but cut retention 12%.

first.rationale: Onboarding completion is down 4% QoQ, and prior evidence indicates both reduced signup friction and shorter onboarding durably improved activation, completion, time-to-value, and early adoption. This directly addresses the current funnel deterioration while supporting sustainable qualified revenue. Promotional pricing is not preferred because prior SMB discounts harmed retention despite short-term acquisition gains; the archived onboarding records should be verified before commitment.
